headline: How group-chat investment scams work
sub: The SEC's warning pattern, step by step

cards.label: The hook
cards.body: A stranger posing as an expert invites you to a chat promoting AI trading.

cards.label: Fake gains
cards.body: A fake app shows big 'profits' that are just numbers on a screen.

cards.label: The trap
cards.body: To withdraw, you're told to pay 'fees' or 'taxes' first. Then they vanish.

footer: Verify registration before sending any money
